title: Composition of normalized strict scalar pullback towers
statement: Let l,E,L,F,iota,j,f:X to Y and P be as in [lem-pur-integral-scalar-pullback-level-composition]. Form the strict reduction towers of [lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined] and the normalized scalarPullbackTower transformations of [lem-pur-integral-scalar-finite-comparison-models]. The scalar extension by L to F of the E-to-L tower map, followed by the L-to-F tower map and the F-pullback tower map of the ordinary scalar associator on Y, equals the towerwise scalar associator on X followed by the direct E-to-F tower map for j composed with iota. The associator is that of [lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition]. This is an equality of natural transformations between strict towers, before applying Roos.

source.place: Coefficient coherence for tensor reassociation and adjunction units; normalized finite pullback comparisons and the associated strict reduction towers (Stacks 03EL, 07A4, 08TC).

proof.text: Use extensionality of natural transformations in the tower index n. The chosen strict comparison has at n exactly the chosen normalized scalarPullbackLevel component. Substituting these component equations changes the desired identity to finite-level scalar pullback composition, which holds by the proved finite-level theorem. The tower map induced by the input associator evaluates to the finite pullback of that chain map by the definition of the strict tower functor.

theorem integralScalarPullbackTowerComposition {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ) :
    Functor.whiskerRight ((scalarPullbackTower l E L ι f).app P)
        ((integralOrdinaryScalar l L F j X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) ≫
      (scalarPullbackTower l L F j f).app
        (((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι Y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
      (integralOperationsPullbackTowerFunctor l F f).map
        ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (integralOrdinaryScalarComp l E L ι Y F j)
          (.up ℤ)).hom.app P) =
    Functor.whiskerLeft ((integralOperationsPullbackTowerFunctor l E f).obj P)
      ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (integralOrdinaryScalarComp l E L ι X F j)
        (.up ℤ)).hom) ≫ (scalarPullbackTower l E F (j.comp ι) f).app P
